clue.text: Gains honours

definitions.meaning: a share that gains rises in value
to honour someone is to value and esteem them

explanation.definitionFit: Assets that increase in worth do this, and a person who holds another in high regard does it too.

clue.text: Affected, that's taken for granted

definitions.meaning: an affected manner is put on, feigned

explanation.definitionFit: A false name or pose is one that is put on, and a premise accepted without proof is one supposed true.

clue.text: A supplementary note about time sheets

indicators.note: the note is wrapped around the period of time

parts.note: a postscript, PS, is a note added at the end of a letter
an age is a long period of time

explanation.surface: Someone describing an addendum about a timesheet at work.
explanation.definitionFit: Leaves of paper in a book are its sheets.

clue.text: The look-out man appears uncommonly green

parts.note: extra as an adverb means unusually, exceptionally
vert is green in heraldry

explanation.surface: A sentry seems unusually inexperienced or envious.
explanation.walkthrough: VERT is the heraldic word for green. The definition is playful: an outgoing person looks outward rather than inward.
explanation.definitionFit: An outgoing personality type directs attention outwards, so is jokingly a man who looks out.

clue.text: A piece read in a favourite magazine

indicators.note: the word is to be read inside the run of letters of the following words

explanation.surface: An article to be read in a well-loved periodical.
explanation.definitionFit: A news story or article is an individual piece in a publication.

clue.text: Retraces different walks

indicators.note: the letters of the word are made different, i.e. rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone retracing their steps along different footpaths.
explanation.definitionFit: Raised level walkways in a garden or park are sometimes called by this name.

clue.text: Desert as singular article is being written up

indicators.note: in a down clue, written up means the letters run from bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: I, the single figure one, stands for a singular
an is the indefinite article
taken as written

explanation.surface: A grammar note about a singular article being written up into a word about a desert.
explanation.walkthrough: 'being written up' turns I + AN + IS, giving the peninsula's name.
explanation.definitionFit: The peninsula between Egypt and Israel is largely arid wilderness, a desert of that name.

clue.text: A tip coppers are not at all happy about

parts.note: pennies are coppers, and P is the abbreviation for pence

parts.words: are not at all happy about
parts.note: to resent something is to be unhappy about it

explanation.surface: Police officers unhappy about being offered a gratuity.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coppers' suggests police but means pennies, P.
explanation.definitionFit: A gratuity is a gift of money, so a tip is a kind of gift.

clue.text: Means of ensuring the desired expansion

definitions.text: Means of ensuring the desired expansion

parts.words: Means of ensuring the desired expansion
parts.note: reads like economic policy, but describes the darkroom device that blows up a photographic print to a bigger size

explanation.definitionFit: A photographic device projects a negative so the print comes out bigger.

clue.text: A person looking round finds these girls left out, sadly

indicators.note: sadly signals the remaining letters end up in a poor, jumbled state
out tells us the letter for left is dropped from the girls' letters

explanation.surface: A tourist discovers, regrettably, that these young women have been excluded.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' takes L ('left') from THESE GIRLS, and 'sadly' rearranges the remaining THESEGIRS.
explanation.definitionFit: A tourist goes round viewing the attractions of a place.

clue.text: 7 some are given on certain occasions

definitions.note: the answer to 7 down, in its sense of the current time

indicators.note: some of the letters in the words that follow are taken, the run that sits inside them

explanation.surface: Gifts, some of which are handed over on special occasions.
explanation.walkthrough: The 7 refers to 7 down, read not as gifts but as the current moment; 'some' takes a run from GIVEN ON CERTAIN OCCASIONS, and the surface just describes gifts.
explanation.definitionFit: The old word for the current occasion survives in the phrase meaning for the time being.

clue.text: There's many a ship-wreck caused by accident

parts.note: M, the Roman numeral for a thousand, stands for many

indicators.note: to wreck something is to break it up, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Many a shipwreck has been the result of a mishap at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: An unlucky accident is a minor misfortune.

clue.text: Jokey talk that's attractive only to the young

definitions.meaning: read as three words, something ... is unattractive to the old

explanation.definitionFit: Light-hearted teasing repartee is banter; split into three words it says something is poor once old.

clue.text: The mother bird will get wet

parts.note: a dam is the mother of an animal, especially a horse
a pen is a female swan

explanation.surface: A mother bird about to get soaked.
explanation.walkthrough: DAM is a mother animal and PEN is a female swan.
explanation.definitionFit: To moisten something is to make it damp.

clue.text: Government official a collier set about first

indicators.note: the coal worker's letters are set about, around, the other piece

parts.note: a collier is a coal miner
1st, written IST, is first

explanation.surface: A coal miner who got started first as a politician.
explanation.definitionFit: A senior member of a government who heads a department holds this title.

clue.text: Party conservatives straightened out

parts.note: a set is a group or party of people
the right is the conservative wing in politics

explanation.surface: Members of a political party who have corrected the record.
explanation.definitionFit: To correct or put things in order is to put them straight.

clue.text: Show there's point in the right 7

parts.note: R is the abbreviation for right
E, east, is a point of the compass
the answer to 7 down

explanation.surface: Displaying the point inside the right gift.
explanation.definitionFit: To depict or portray something is to show it.

clue.text: A help to a musician with pluck

definitions.text: A help to a musician with pluck

parts.words: A help to a musician with pluck
parts.note: pluck seems to mean courage, but it is plucking strings, done with a small pick

explanation.definitionFit: A guitarist's small pick is used to pluck the strings.

clue.text: Exceptionally neatly or fussily?

indicators.note: exceptionally suggests the letters are laid out in an unusual order

explanation.surface: Is someone exceptionally neat, or just fussy?
explanation.definitionFit: Doing something with elaborate decoration is doing it fussily.

clue.text: Work in mid-air on view

parts.note: OP, short for opus, is a work
taken as written

indicators.note: mid-air asks for the middle letter of the word air

parts.note: taken as written

explanation.surface: Work done in mid-air, on view to all.
explanation.definitionFit: A personal belief or viewpoint is one's view.

clue.text: Good fellows left on board

indicators.note: on board means inside the ship, so one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: SS, steamship, is the usual crossword ship to be on board
port is the left side of a ship

explanation.surface: Decent chaps left aboard ship.
explanation.walkthrough: Being 'on board' is being inside SS, the steamship.
explanation.definitionFit: Decent, good-natured people are called good fellows.

clue.text: The firm in a rush to get a cat

indicators.note: the company goes inside the rush

parts.note: a surge is a sudden rush
CO is short for company, a firm

explanation.surface: A company rushing to get a cat.
explanation.walkthrough: The cat is the cat-o'-nine-tails, a whip.
explanation.definitionFit: A multi-thonged whip, the cat-o'-nine-tails, is a lash.

clue.text: An example of the fashionable stand

parts.note: in means fashionable
a stance is a stand or position

explanation.surface: A case of taking the trendy position.
explanation.definitionFit: A case is an example.

clue.text: A deviant lied and suffered for it

indicators.note: deviant suggests the letters stray from their normal order

explanation.surface: A deviant who lied and paid for it.
explanation.definitionFit: Being ill means suffering.

clue.text: Have a hankering for a penthouse?

definitions.meaning: in its old sense, a shed with a sloping roof against a wall

explanation.definitionFit: To incline towards is to favour; a penthouse originally meant a sloping-roofed annexe built against a wall.

clue.text: The woman getting up at ten

indicators.note: in a down clue getting up means the words are read from bottom to top

explanation.surface: A woman getting out of bed at ten o'clock.
explanation.definitionFit: A girl's name stands for any woman.

clue.text: Scandinavian got of love-a big noise

parts.note: love is nil in tennis, the letter O
a din is a loud noise

explanation.surface: A Norse deity of love who makes a racket.
explanation.walkthrough: Love is O, zero in tennis scoring. He is not actually the god of love.
explanation.definitionFit: The chief of the Norse pantheon was a Scandinavian god.

clue.text: A figure initially thought perfect

indicators.note: initially says the notion comes first, before the figure

parts.note: an idea is a thought
L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: A number, at first considered faultless.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' puts IDEA first, then L, the Roman figure fifty.
explanation.definitionFit: Something flawless is perfect.

clue.text: Plainly embarrassed by a planter — quite a dog!

parts.note: someone visibly embarrassed goes red
a setter is one who sets or plants

explanation.surface: A gardener blushing over a fine dog.
explanation.walkthrough: The Irish setter is a breed of gun dog.
explanation.definitionFit: The Irish setter, a gun dog breed with a chestnut coat, is known by this name.

clue.text: Having to tend mares possibly for show

indicators.note: possibly signals one possible arrangement of the letters

explanation.surface: Someone who must look after horses for a show.
explanation.definitionFit: To exhibit or display something is to show it.
